## Theme

A [`Theme`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/core.html#theme) is the
app’s default look. `name` picks a preset from `THEMES`. `radius`,
`shadow` and `size` become `<html>` attributes, so a reader’s choice in
the browser replaces them. `primary`, `font`, `display`, `scale` and
`tokens` become one unlayered `:root` rule, which beats the presets and
Oat; your own unlayered CSS beats it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/fhoat/blob/main/fhoat/core.py#L68"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### Theme

``` python
def Theme(
    name:str=None, primary:str | tuple=None, radius:str=None, shadow:str=None, size:str=None, font:str=None,
    display:str=None, scale:float=None, tokens:dict=None
)->None:
```

*The app’s default look: a preset `name`, an accent, corners, shadows,
text size, type, scale and raw Oat tokens.*

``` python
th = Theme(name='paper', primary=('#8a1f11', '#dcae6d'), radius='lg', font='serif', tokens=dict(container_max='60rem'), scale=1.1)
assert th.attrs() == dict(data_theme='paper', data_radius='lg')
assert '--primary:light-dark(#8a1f11, #dcae6d)' in th.css() and '--primary-foreground:light-dark(#fafafa, #0a0a0a)' in th.css()
assert '--container-max:60rem' in th.css() and 'font-size:110%' in th.css() and Theme().css() == ''
for bad in (dict(tokens=dict(x='red}</style><script>')), dict(tokens={'a;b': '1'}), dict(primary='red;x:y'), dict(radius='huge')):
    try: Theme(**bad); raise AssertionError(bad)
    except ValueError: pass
th.css()
```

## Headers

[`oat_hdrs`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/core.html#oat_hdrs)
gives the head tags;
[`oat_htmlkw`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/core.html#oat_htmlkw)
the `<html>` attrs that go with them. Each layer can be left out: an app
with its own look passes `restyle=False`, an app with its own mode
script `presets=False, script=False`, an app drawn on Oat 1.0
`compat=True`.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/fhoat/blob/main/fhoat/core.py#L116"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### oat_htmlkw

``` python
def oat_htmlkw(
    theme:bool=True, mode:str='auto', tips:bool=True, store:NoneType=None
):
```

*The `<html>` attrs fhoat.js reads: mode and look; `tips=False` hides
Oat’s tooltips; `store` names the localStorage key.*

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/fhoat/blob/main/fhoat/core.py#L105"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### oat_hdrs

``` python
def oat_hdrs(
    theme:bool=True, cdn:bool=False, prefix:str='/fhoat', compat:bool=False, presets:bool=True, components:bool=True,
    restyle:bool=True, script:bool=True
):
```

*Head tags: Oat, then fhoat’s `presets`, `components` and `restyle`
layers and its `script`; `cdn` takes Oat from jsDelivr (with SRI).*

``` python
h = to_xml(oat_hdrs('blue', compat=True))
assert '/fhoat/oat.min.css?v=' in h and 'oat10.css' in h and 'oat10.js' in h and 'window.fhoat' in h and '=>' in h
h = to_xml(oat_hdrs(restyle=False, presets=False, components=False, script=False, prefix='/css/fhoat/'))
assert '/css/fhoat/oat.min.css?v=' in h and 'themes.css' not in h and 'fhoat.css' not in h and 'window.fhoat' not in h
assert 'integrity="sha384-' in to_xml(oat_hdrs(cdn=True)) and oatcss in to_xml(oat_hdrs(cdn=True))
assert oat_htmlkw(Theme(name='ink', size='lg'), tips=False, store='app') == dict(data_mode='auto', data_theme='ink', data_size='lg', data_tips='off', data_store='app')
```

## Serving and setup

[`serve_oat`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/core.html#serve_oat)
serves `OAT_DIR` ahead of FastHTML’s static catch-all, cached for a year
(each URL carries a content hash).
[`setup_oat`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/core.html#setup_oat)
does all of it on an existing app, the way `setup_toasts` does for
FastHTML’s toasts: Oat’s headers go first in `app.hdrs`, its attrs into
`app.htmlkw` (your own keys win), and the files get a route. It runs
once per app.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/fhoat/blob/main/fhoat/core.py#L133"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### setup_oat

``` python
def setup_oat(
    app, theme:bool=True, mode:str='auto', tips:bool=True, store:NoneType=None, **oat_kw
):
```

*Put Oat and fhoat on an existing FastHTML app: headers, `<html>` attrs
and the file route. `oat_kw` goes to
[`oat_hdrs`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/core.html#oat_hdrs).*

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/fhoat/blob/main/fhoat/core.py#L122"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

``` python
def serve_oat(

```

*Serve fhoat’s files at `prefix`, ahead of fast_app’s static catch-all,

### fast_app

``` python
def fast_app(
    *args, oat:bool=True, mode:str='auto', tips:bool=True, store:NoneType=None, oat_kw:NoneType=None,
    db_file:Optional[str]=None, render:Optional[<built-in function callable>]=None, hdrs:Optional[tuple]=None,
    ftrs:Optional[tuple]=None, tbls:Optional[dict]=None,
    before:Union[tuple, NoneType, fasthtml.core.Beforeware]=None, middleware:Optional[tuple]=None, live:bool=False,
    debug:bool=False, title:str='FastHTML page', routes:Optional[tuple]=None, exception_handlers:Optional[dict]=None,
    on_startup:Optional[<built-in function callable>]=None, on_shutdown:Optional[<built-in function callable>]=None,
    lifespan:Optional[<built-in function callable>]=None, default_hdrs:bool=True, surreal:Optional[bool]=True,
    htmx:Optional[bool]=True, htmx4:Optional[bool]=False, exts:Union[list, str, NoneType]=None, canonical:bool=True,
    secret_key:Optional[str]=None, key_fname:str='.sesskey', session_cookie:str='session_', max_age:int=31536000,
    sess_path:str='/', same_site:str='lax', sess_https_only:bool=False, sess_domain:Optional[str]=None,
    htmlkw:Optional[dict]=None, bodykw:Optional[dict]=None, reload_attempts:Optional[int]=1,
    reload_interval:Optional[int]=1000, static_path:str='.', body_wrap:<built-in function callable>=noop_body,
    nb_hdrs:bool=False, **kw
):
```

*FastHTML’s
[`fast_app`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/core.html#fast_app)
with `oat` in place of `pico`: True, a preset name, a dict or a
[`Theme`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/core.html#theme); `oat_kw`
goes to
[`oat_hdrs`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/core.html#oat_hdrs).*

One call gives an app with Oat, fhoat’s look and the reader’s mode and
theme:

``` python
from starlette.testclient import TestClient
app, rt = fast_app(oat='blue')
@rt
def index(): return Titled('Hello', P('Oat'))
c = TestClient(app)
t = c.get('/').text
assert 'data-theme="blue"' in t and '/fhoat/oat.min.css?v=' in t and 'pico' not in t
assert t.index('oat.min.css') < t.index('htmx')
assert c.get('/fhoat/oat.min.js').headers['cache-control'].endswith('immutable') and c.get('/fhoat/core.py').status_code == 404
assert 'pico' in fast_app(oat=False)[0].hdrs.__repr__() and fast_app(pico=True)[0]
```

An existing app, or one built with `FastHTML(...)`, takes
[`setup_oat`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/core.html#setup_oat):

``` python
app = FastHTML()
setup_oat(app, 'teal', compat=True); setup_oat(app, 'teal')
assert len([r for r in app.router.routes if getattr(r, 'path', '') == '/fhoat/{fname}']) == 1 and app.htmlkw['data_theme'] == 'teal'
```
